confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregated Australian price evidence: a cost-of-living aggregator, a national coffee survey, and city-level drink guides for Sydney and Melbourne. These are undated, crowd-sourced or city-based figures, and no Byron Bay-specific aggregate was found, so a tourist-town premium was applied by judgement. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail and wine anchors are less certain and rely on city guide figures. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season coastal resort town, were not checked against live listings or searched, and are the least certain; treat hostel and hotel tiers as broad bands.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct Byron Bay aggregate was found. Food and drink were benchmarked to Australian national and Sydney/Melbourne averages, with a modest upward adjustment for a small, tourist-heavy coastal town in July. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a regional NSW coastal town in peak winter-holiday season, not based on searched listings.
